monument.A1: A conveyor sets you down at the welcome wall, where a screen shows your face and the word WELCOME. Your first duty toward Certification: stand in the road until a colleague notices you.
monument.B1: Battery 1 is fitted, for the dash. Shoppers never came to the podium bridge; staff now watch from it as you dash into a colleague, toward Certification.
monument.C1: The LED drum lights each bend so no colleague is surprised. Where the high road breaks its rail over the street, step off onto a car below: gravity is company policy.
monument.C2: The raised road passes through the portal tower, above its tenants. Your write-off belongs on that road, at height; Certification does not include the view.
monument.B2: The monument's plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS, a target rather than a record. Stand or walk beside it and let a colleague find you; dashing would spoil the data.
monument.A2: The neon shops under the highway sell nothing, yet the traffic reads every sign. Hands 1 is fitted: place a cone, and let a colleague who reads it write you off.
monument.A3: Each stacked cube was added as the budget arrived, one on the last; we call this growth. Your duty grows the same way: one hit, then another before the first is forgotten.
monument.B3: Legs 1 is fitted. In the LED canyon, two screens advertise across the road all night; jump into a car between them, for our clients.
monument.C3: The LED gateway thanks every car for driving safely, even the one that wrote you off. Your file reads ROLE: DESTRUCTIVE TESTING; let one colleague throw you into the next.

parkland.C1: The paper lantern, the Expo's first exhibit, is lit again for our clients. Arms 1 is fitted: under the footbridge, push off one car into the next, and the Expo opens safer.
parkland.C2: Our board will watch from these terraces on opening day, and every crossing of the avenue is a performance. A van delivers the catering; arrange for it to deliver you.
parkland.C3: The arch is the Expo's gate; visitors will circle the roundabout once before they enter. Go round faster, and chain your hits before the first is forgotten.
parkland.B3: The obelisk marks the surveyors' first stake; on opening day the police fleet escorts a school party here. Your final hit must come from a police car: the escort is tested on you first.
parkland.A3: A wedding is booked on the belvedere for opening day, facing the traffic. Legs 2 is fitted: jump into a car here, so that no guest ever does.
parkland.A2: The dome by the canal is the Expo's showroom, readied for our clients. Hands 2 is fitted: lay a cone, and let the car that answers it write you off.
parkland.A1: At the reservoir terraces, the gardener tends three pools by hand; she asks that cars stop before the water. Arms 2 is fitted; teach them with a ricochet, one car to the next.
parkland.B1: The cascade steps the reservoir's water down beside the highway, pool by pool, to drown out the traffic. Go up to the highway and take your write-off where the traffic is loudest.
parkland.B2: Battery 2 is fitted: a second charge. The board watches the ring over the pools; carry the chain your brief asks for, and the Expo opens to clients.

waterfront.A1: Before you cross the river to our clients, we require the bus fleet's data. At the west portal, the bus carries engineers from the upper town to the bridge; stand in its path.
waterfront.B1: Legs 3 is fitted for the longest flight. At the tunnel portal, cars go in under the hill and data comes back; jump into one, and your data serves our clients.
waterfront.C1: The east bridge was built to correct the west; its portal block faces the other way. The police here check papers, and a police car's final hit moves yours forward.
waterfront.C2: From the rail of the east beach terrace, you can see the ships that carry Certified dummies to clients. Drop onto a car below; the ships will wait.
waterfront.C3: The east pier tower is a customs post; it logs every Certified dummy that crosses the river to our clients. Be thrown into a car while a hit still throws you, and earn your entry.
waterfront.B3: Arms 3 is fitted; push off one car into the next. Behind glass in the stilt houses stands Chassis 0, the prototype before you; show it how far the model has come.
waterfront.A3: At the west customs post, the log lists every dummy bound for clients across the river. Your entry reads PURPOSE DESTRUCTION; honour it on the raised road.
waterfront.A2: The west beach terrace was laid with sand from three provinces, for clients you will one day serve. Place a cone and meet the car that reacts to it; every write-off here serves them.
waterfront.B2: Battery 3 is fitted: complete the chain your brief sets, and you are Certified for our clients. The circus island's monument, cast from every write-off, reads ZERO ACCIDENTS (EXCLUDING TESTS).

acts.monument: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. The cars are your colleagues; Certification is your goal.
acts.parkland: The Expo opens to clients when this park passes. Your training keeps them safe.
acts.waterfront: Certified dummies ship across the river, to be sacrificed in service to our clients. Your papers are being prepared.

any.label: ANY WRITE-OFF
any.brief: General coverage. Any write-off in this tile counts.

dash.label: DASH INTO A CAR
dash.brief: Coverage gap: dashes. The final hit must be a dash into a car.

drop.label: DROP ONTO A CAR
drop.brief: Coverage gap: falls. The final hit must be a drop onto a car from above.

jump.label: JUMP INTO A CAR
jump.brief: Coverage gap: jumps. The final hit must be a jump into a car.

level.label: ON A RAISED ROAD
level.brief: Coverage gap: raised roads. The final hit must land at Z1 or above.

cone.label: CONE-BAITED CAR
cone.brief: Coverage gap: cones. The final hit must come from a car reacting to a cone.

push.label: PUSH OFF A CAR
push.brief: Coverage gap: ricochets. Push off one car; the final hit must be the next car.

bounce.label: THROWN INTO A CAR
bounce.brief: Coverage gap: rebounds. The final hit must come while a hit is still throwing you.

struck.label: STRUCK, NOT DASHING
struck.brief: Coverage gap: pedestrians. The final hit must be a car hitting you while you walk or stand.

combo.label: COMBO ×{n}
combo.brief: Coverage gap: chains. The final hit must be link {n} or later of a combo.

cls.label: A {cls}
cls.brief: Coverage gap: the {clsLong}. The final hit must come from a {cls}.

ending: Your model has passed and will be manufactured for our clients. A Corporation drone carries you to the ship.

notices.n01: You are a Dummy Corporation trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n02: Welcome, trainee. Every write-off brings Certification closer.
notices.n03: Shenzhen Smart City, tile by tile. Each tile trains you to its brief.
notices.n13: A Corporation drone brings this part.
notices.n14: A Corporation drone brings this part. Keep training.
notices.n15: A Corporation drone brings that part
notices.n17: Corporation drone dispatched: chassis in the river
notices.n18: Corporation drone dispatched. Obstruction will be relocated.
notices.n19: Corporation drone: chassis recovered from the river
notices.n20: Training complete. The Corporation thanks you for your service.
notices.n21: Traffic exhausted. Training incomplete; report to the bay.
notices.n24: Neon shops, LED walls; one road splits round the monument under the walkway ring. Your training begins here.
notices.n25: Water and concrete; a boulevard passes under the raised ring. Your write-offs open the Expo to clients.
notices.n26: A hill walled by towers; bridges cross the drive and the river. Certified dummies ship across it to clients.
notices.n28: Towers and barriers. Corporation Tower stands over your training.
notices.n29: The test centre the city was modelled on. Hits on its impact plates count for more.
notices.n30: Two flyovers cross it, one above the other. Corporation Tower stands at the centre; towers shade your training.
notices.n31: Impact plates mark the road at the centre. A write-off on a plate counts for more.

b013.text: OI! Right in the grille, kind regards.

b034.text: A write-off on my record. Unthinkable.

b052.text: Too slow, ha! Have a nice day!

b061.text: It lunged and nothing happened. Same.

b081.text: Move. I have a schedule, and standards.

c024.text: Hit on campus. That goes on my record.
